fusions.name: Krill Storm
fusions.desc: Looses 5 clouds of krill at once, spread apart, each dealing 26 damage. Against a boss or elite each also deals 4% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Stripping Gulp
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A gulping blow that deals 8 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.5 times at maximum range.

fusions.name: Swarm Pasture
fusions.desc: Calls a swarm to the nearest enemy for 10 seconds, striking for 4 damage every second.

fusions.name: Gorged
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 4 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
